Stone-filled truck near Jantar Mantar sparks claims and counter-claims

A truck filled with stones found near Jantar Mantar has become the center of a dispute, with reports indicating it was in Delhi Police custody for four days prior to its discovery. The Delhi Police lawyer linked the truck to protesters in court, while the Congress party called it a "major security failure." Families of injured Delhi Police officers claim outsiders infiltrated the Jantar Mantar protest, leading to violence that injured 200 officers. The truck's ownership and placement have been questioned, with some reports suggesting it was parked outside the Youth Congress office.
